goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

Checkout page first showed only a Loading image with no text; I heard nothing useful until I re-read, and it was unclear when the form was ready.
The Email Address, Phone Number tooltip buttons have an empty name, so I heard only Tooltip with no explanation of what it does.
After choosing State and typing the ZIP, shipping options turned disabled and a Loading image appeared with no announcement; I could not tell the form was updating.
Shipping radios are in table cells with the price in a separate cell, and the radio had no checked state until I pressed Space; focusing it did not select it and the Next step was not explained.

After pressing Next, no announcement of moving to the Review and Payments step; the page showed a loading image and No Payment Methods first, then the payment form appeared only after another read. The edit buttons in the order summary have no useful names (only an icon and the word edit).
